requirement_vague: Verify user profile update modifies user data correctly
requirement_precise: Create a user with username 'updateuser1', email 'updateuser1@test.com', password 'pass123'. Extract the token. PUT /api/user with body {"user": {"bio": "Updated bio text", "image": "https://example.com/newimage.jpg"}}. Verify response status is 200. Verify response contains updated bio 'Updated bio text' and image 'https://example.com/newimage.jpg'. GET /api/user with the token. Verify the updated bio and image persisted.

implementation.reasoning: The service supports authenticated PUT /api/user, updates the current user's bio and image from the request body, commits the changes, and returns the updated user payload with the default 200 status. GET /api/user uses the authenticated current user from the database and returns bio and image via user_response, so the updated values persist and are returned on subsequent reads.
